execution_policy: CPU/read-only audit; no GPU program or scheduler command invoked

status_vocabulary.STATIC: Derived from archived source/build commands and audited input metadata.
status_vocabulary.RUNTIME: Validated only for the queries in an existing log.
status_vocabulary.NOT_RUN: No matching execution was performed or consumed.
status_vocabulary.NOT_PROVEN: Available evidence cannot establish the claimed bound.

static_contracts.proof: CSR row, destination, edge counts, partition bounds, and graph sizes are int; every audited value is checked below INT32_MAX.
VALUE_TYPE is signed int and hot-path additions are unchecked. Unit-weight graphs have a sufficient n*max_weight bound; atmosmodm, rmat22, and USA G+ do not.

The INT_MAX-byte request rounds down to 16 rings of 16,776,704 records; modulo addresses remain inside 268,435,455 allocated records. The implementation explicitly does not handle signed counter overflow and has no fullness guard.
Candidate/cache arrays have peer_vertices+1 entries; candidate IDs are 1..peer_vertices and mark/hint indexes are ceil-divided from 0-based peer IDs. Compact mode retains dense candidate allocations.
Only peer-local destinations in [0,peer_size) enter the index. Sparse storage is allocated only below half the dense word count; dense mode allocates no index buffer.
Each receiver owns two (local_vertices+1)-record slots. Published count is clamped to peer_vertices, which equals the receiver local size for n=2; slot offsets fit int for every audited partition.

The retained journal is the same 32*128 shared entries (32,768 bytes for ID and distance arrays), not a second global allocation. Extraction clamps l3_cnt to 4,096 and leaves overflow marked for a later scan.

Exactly one selected queue workspace per GPU allocates the L2 queue and reuses it across sources. WORK_COUNT=false removes the histogram/counter allocations; QUERY_WORKSPACE_DIAG is not enabled, so free-memory peak is NOT_RUN.
A100 allocates (108-1)*16=1,712 slots and runtime work blocks are clamped to at most 107. Latest logs report active_slots=capacity=1,712 on both GPUs.

legacy_log_gate.rule: For every dual-GPU sample and GPU, parse the matching L2_CAPACITY and require L2_FINAL writes < per_bucket, plus reads == writes == completed.
legacy_log_gate.proof: Every physical bucket's cumulative writes are at most the aggregate writes across all buckets. If the aggregate is below one bucket's capacity, no bucket can execute even one modulo wrap.
legacy_log_gate.failure_semantics: aggregate writes >= per_bucket is NOT_PROVEN, not evidence that an overwrite occurred.

preferred_exact_source_gate.rule: In report_final_l2_counts, compute max_bucket_writes from the already copied write_reserve array and emit per_bucket_capacity, counter_bits, and no_wrap=(max_bucket_writes <= q.total_size). Have the formal runner require no_wrap=1. Equality is safe: exactly capacity writes address indices 0..capacity-1 once.
preferred_exact_source_gate.terminology: Call this no_wrap, not universal no_overwrite: a future run may safely wrap after consumption, which needs a peak-outstanding diagnostic.
preferred_exact_source_gate.counter_scope: write_total <= INT32_MAX proves the aggregate read_done/debug totals, not every signed counter in arbitrary runs. For a blanket counter claim, also bound/log read_ptr and first_pos; write_total <= INT32_MAX/BNUM is a simple conservative current-build first_pos gate.

peak_outstanding_extension.rule: If max_bucket_writes exceeds capacity but the workload must still be accepted, use an isolated diagnostic build to record a conservative per-bucket maximum of write_reserve - bucket_read_done at reservation.

index_ranges_for_current_n2_build.scope: Audited graph/partition, candidate, bitmap, inbox, boundary, retained journal, and ACK indexes only.

l2_ring_no_overwrite.reason: Delaunay_n23 and latest compact USA have all-bucket totals above one bucket capacity; aggregate final conservation cannot establish peak per-bucket occupancy.

signed_counter_overflow.reason: Logged final totals are below INT32_MAX, but the queue source explicitly excludes counter-overflow handling and no max read_ptr/write_reserve diagnostic is logged.

checked_int32_candidate_addition.reason: Correct final output and int64 oracle agreement do not prove every transient signed int addition avoided overflow.
